disputes.cashNote: Cash goes directly to the professional: the platform can only refund its commission.

doHint.proposal: Both parties see the proposal and get a notification.
doHint.refer: The parties are told they can contact an insurer, lawyer, authority or court.
doHint.request_response: The parties get a new deadline to answer.
doHint.settle: Record the outcome. The dispute closes; the order is closed.

disputes.notCourt: Support helps the parties agree. Its decision is not a court ruling and must not promise compensation the platform has no basis for.
disputes.refundFinanceOnly: A commission refund can be made only by finance.
disputes.refundLabel: Refund commission to the professional (up to {{max}})

disputes.summary: What was agreed (visible to both parties)
disputes.suspiciousHint: The professional marked “Arrived” while the GPS track was far from the address.

documents.emptyQueue: The queue is empty — all documents are reviewed.

finance.badPeriod: The start date must not be later than the end date.
finance.integrityBad: Ledger check failed: sum of entries {{total}}, mismatched accounts {{accounts}}. Notify the engineers.
finance.integrityOk: Ledger is balanced: all entries sum to zero and cached balances match.

finance.title: Finance

explain.CASH_HIDDEN_ORDER: Signs that the order was done but cancelled to avoid commission.
explain.GPS_MISMATCH: Marked “Arrived” while the track was far from the address.
explain.HIGH_CANCEL_RATE: Many cancellations or a cancellation reason that points to the professional.
explain.MULTI_ACCOUNT: Signs of several accounts of one person.
explain.OFF_PLATFORM_ATTEMPT: Contacts in chat or a client says the professional asked to pay outside the app.
explain.REFUND_SPIKE: A bank chargeback on a top-up.
explain.SUSPICIOUS_PAIR: The same client and professional too often or share a device.
explain.TOPUP_SPIKE: Unusually many top-ups in a short time.

fraud.resolveHint: Describe what you found and what you did (warning, block, nothing). The note goes to the audit log.

incidents.noPromises: Masterio is not an insurer. Help the parties contact the responsible company and their insurer; do not promise payments.

insurance.empty: No rules — only service flags apply.
insurance.noGuarantee: Checking a policy is not a guarantee of cover for a specific event, and the platform does not insure anyone.
insurance.order: The most specific rule wins: service + type → service → type → whole country. Without rules the “insurance required” flag of the service applies.
insurance.risksHint: The policy must list each of these risks exactly as entered by the professional, e.g. liability.
insurance.sub: Which professionals must have a valid policy, by country, service and type.
insurance.title: Insurance rules
